body: [{"streamId":"01a1af23-3fc8-767b-9314-f8588e385e39","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Decision.DecisionRecorded","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1af23-3fc8-767b-9314-f8588e385e39\u0022,\u0022Scope\u0022:\u0022Project\u0022,\u0022ScopeId\u0022:\u002201a1a29e-778a-7730-9f07-304d9ac0ffeb\u0022,\u0022Statement\u0022:\u0022A pull request review comment whose author is a trusted author may steer a step with write power; any other comment stays untrusted under design section 9. A trusted author is a member of the project, matched by the software module from the comment\\u0027s code-host login to that member, or an account the project\\u0027s owner lists on the project, such as Copilot. An untrusted comment may be read only by a step with a narrow tool set, which may summarise it for a human, and never reaches a step that writes. Whatever the author, a fix that changes the repository\\u0027s CI configuration or its agent configuration waits for the owner\\u0027s approval.
